preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000), and the second line contains exactly n integers representing the array a.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a satisfies 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) > 0 and all(1 <= int(u) < int(v) <= n for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: If no valid list exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is an integer m (0 ≤ m ≤ n(n-1)/2), followed by m lines of pairs (u_i, v_i) where 1 ≤ u_i < v_i ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) == 0 or (all(u < v for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]) and all(line.split() not in [other.split() for other in stdout.split()[1:]] for i, line in enumerate(stdout.split()[1:]) for other in stdout.split()[1:i+1]))
postconditions.description: All pairs in the list are distinct and satisfy u_i < v_i.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) == 0 or (all(u < v for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]) and all(a[int(u)-1] > a[int(v)-1] for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: Every pair (u_i, v_i) in the list is an inversion in the original array a.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) == 0 or (all(u < v for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]) and all(a_sorted[int(u)-1] <= a_sorted[int(v)-1] for u, v in [(int(line.split()[0])-1, int(line.split()[1])-1) for line in stdout.split()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: After applying all swaps in the list to the original array a, the resulting array is sorted in non-decreasing order, where a_sorted is the sorted version of the original array.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (m := int(stdout.split()[0])) == 0 or (all(u < v for line in stdout.split()[1:] for u, v in [line.split()]) and all(a_sorted[int(u)-1] <= a_sorted[int(v)-1] for u, v in [(int(line.split()[0])-1, int(line.split()[1])-1) for line in stdout.split()[1:]])) and (a_sorted := sorted([int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: The list of pairs, if non-empty, must include all inversions in the original array a (i.e., every pair (u, v) where u < v and a[u-1] > a[v-1] must be in the list).
